answer:
The highest paid agency head in OPAX's pay records is the Secretary of the Example Department, at **$1,034,780** a year in total remuneration from 2025-07-01 [1]. The next highest are the heads of the Example Treasury Office and the Example Defence Office, each above $950,000 [2]. These figures come from Remuneration Tribunal determinations, which set pay for departmental secretaries and many statutory office holders [1][2].

- Speeches have discussed these salaries, for example in Senate estimates [3].
- Some agency heads are paid under their own instrument and are not in this list.
